package.author: Silviu Vlasceanu
package.description: Dynamic Windows 11 Theme, Night Light & Multi-Monitor Hardware Brightness Controller

en-US.author: Silviu Vlasceanu
en-US.description: Dynamic Windows 11 Theme, Night Light & Multi-Monitor Hardware Brightness Controller
en-US.longDescription:
Luminark is a native Windows 11 utility engineered to automatically harmonize your display environment.
It synchronizes Windows system and app themes with day/night schedules or Windows Night Light,
and provides seamless hardware-level multi-monitor brightness control via DDC/CI and WMI.
en-US.name: Luminark
en-US.releaseNotes:
Fixed
- Refresh every primary and secondary taskbar after changing the Windows theme, including explicit shell theme-resource invalidation.
- Serialize and coalesce shell refreshes so rapid theme changes cannot start overlapping broadcasts.
- Read the latest theme when queued preference callbacks run; coalesce duplicate callbacks and ignore pending work after shutdown.
- Add regression coverage for stale theme callbacks, rapid switches, multiple secondary taskbars and disposal.
The Windows installer is unsigned in this release. Trusted publisher signing is deferred until a signing certificate or service is configured.
